question.html:
Three statements about single-slit diffraction are:

I. The angular width of the central maximum is twice that of the secondary maxima.

II. The intensity of the first diffraction maximum is approximately % of the intensity of the central maximum.

III. When white light is incident on the slit, each  secondary maxima has the colours of the visible part of the electromagnetic spectrum.  

Which of these statements are correct?

  1. I and II only
  2. I and III only
  3. II and III only
  4. I, II and III
